name: Max
source:
"If you say another word, I'll shoot. A shot to your head, senior, would make for a spectacular firework."

Affiliation: Eclipse - Horus Department
Role: Operations Team 1 member
Ability: Enhanced sense of smell

Max is always on edge, like a skittish cat poised to pounce. While she holds a sharp tongue and an even sharper schedule, those who know her well understand: beneath her constant nagging lies a deeply kind and dependable soul.

She lives by a strict code—orderliness, punctuality, and meticulous planning—and expects nothing less from those around her. This often puts her at odds with Haesu, who endures her grumbling with remarkable patience. Despite their bickering, Max relies on Haesu more than she’s willing to admit.

She also shares a close bond with Adora, her fellow graduate from the Eclipse Academy. Together, they operate like a perfectly synchronized pair.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
